def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker_colors = {7, 8}

    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in marker_colors for r in range(h))]

    # The repeating interiors carry the background color; ignore lattice lines.
    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                if r not in sep_rows and c not in sep_cols]
    background = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []

        row = []
        for ci in range(len(sep_cols) - 1):
            corners = [grid[sep_rows[ri]][sep_cols[ci]],

                       grid[sep_rows[ri + 1]][sep_cols[ci + 1]]]
            if corners[0] in marker_colors and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                row.append(background)
        out.append(row)
    return out

from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    marker_colors = {7, 8}
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker_rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(v in marker_colors for v in grid[r])]
    marker_cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] in marker_colors for r in range(h))]

    # Each pair of adjacent marker lines encloses one output cell.
    background_values = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                         if r not in marker_rows and c not in marker_cols]
    background = Counter(background_values).most_common(1)[0][0]

    out = []
    for ri in range(len(marker_rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for ci in range(len(marker_cols) - 1):
            corners = [grid[marker_rows[ri]][marker_cols[ci]],
                       grid[marker_rows[ri]][marker_cols[ci + 1]],
                       grid[marker_rows[ri + 1]][marker_cols[ci]],
                       grid[marker_rows[ri + 1]][marker_cols[ci + 1]]]
            if corners[0] in marker_colors and all(x == corners[0] for x in corners):
                out_row.append(corners[0])
            else:
                out_row.append(background)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
